# Launch film notes (28 references)

The written learnings from 28 professionally produced launch films listed in Skale's public portfolio (skale.solutions/portfolio). The films belong to their owners and are **not** included here; links point to the original posts so you can watch them. Timestamps refer to those original posts. View and reach numbers in the portfolio are studio claims, not verified results.

Each entry lists what the film is, one studied moment, the mechanism behind it, and how that mechanism transfers to a business video. The roofing examples come from the case study in `case-study-alder.md`.

Strongest motion-first references: **Contra 24, Wonder 18/19, Bolt 25, Work Louder 22, Replit 11–13, Contra 23, Extend 28, Poke 17, AsideHQ 05**.

---

**01 · TypeSafe** ([post](https://x.com/completeskeptic/status/2099925682726002904)): founder speech intercut with editorial flow diagrams, pink/white/black type, code comparisons and voxel forms.
- **Studied moment:** around 24s, an anchored node and connector stay put while the text changes and a contrasting label arrives.
- **Transfer:** labels can organise an explanation. Keep one visual artifact on screen while the next proposition arrives. Long speaker sections don't suit short ads.

**02 · T:0 finance agent** (portfolio label "Airwallex") ([post](https://x.com/lancectk/status/2094830760410984550)): white/black finance typography, green annotation marks, connected inputs, agent UI.
- **Studied moment:** around 16s, words rearrange into "the pre-AI era", then a green hand-drawn strike lands.
- **Transfer:** fast semantic type changes plus one accent beat.

**03 · Cognition, Devin Voice** ([post](https://x.com/cognition/status/2098142686486356185)): dialogue, a plush character, phone, documentary warmth, thin charts over footage.
- **Studied moment:** around 21s, a chart stays registered over the character while a caption advances.
- **Transfer:** restrained overlays explain a concept. Not a pacing model for motion-first ads.

**04 · Poke × Cognition** ([post](https://x.com/cognition/status/2080311229256540194)): founders, filmed phone UI, warm vignettes, dimensional phone cards, acquisition close.
- **Transfer:** keep the identity of the real business action visible. Holds work when the thing being held is the product action.

**05 · AsideHQ** ([post](https://x.com/hyojun_at/status/2069497198879048131)): a dark "friction" premise gives way to a bright browser workspace doing concrete tasks.
- **Studied moment:** around 18s, a cursor crosses dock icons and the selected app surface expands upward like a fan into the next scene.
- **Transfer:** **an action causes the transition.** Use it for a "request" button expanding into the next state.

**06 · Browserbase** ([post](https://x.com/pk_iv/status/2041518621290266632)): playful bitmap nature, coloured markers, prompt UI, red cursor labels, staged browser tasks.
- **Studied moment:** around 12s, the same page reveals lower cards while the camera pulls back and the cursor keeps tracking its target.
- **Transfer:** overlap nested UI with camera motion and keep the same working surface.

**07 · Poke, drones / flamethrower** ([post](https://x.com/interaction/status/2034713714415608123)): long portrait testimonials and demo, then a travel/phone montage.
- **Studied moment:** around 850s, the phone stays centred and sharp while the background streaks past.
- **Transfer:** keep the subject stable through moving surroundings.

**08 · ListenLabs** ([post](https://x.com/itsalfredw/status/2011469284749594774)): a cream/blue/mustard system; circles turn edge-on and repeat in depth; type expands beyond the frame.
- **Studied moment:** around 17s, a capsule outline draws around a placeholder that swaps to a typed question, with a stable arrow target.
- **Transfer:** custom contours and text-state changes can animate together, and extreme scale contrast gives type energy.

**09 · Buds** ([post](https://x.com/budapp/status/2046605073741119800)): a warm yellow phone/browser sequence; prompt → documents → results; a desktop agent demo.
- **Studied moment:** around 46s, a result moves up, its text follows, and the next result arrives from below, all inside one workspace.
- **Transfer:** change content inside a persistent workspace instead of a sequence of unrelated slides.

**10 · Taste** ([post](https://x.com/thaiscbranco_/status/2066912871649574945)): founder footage, black design systems, perspective galleries, artifact rings, network scenes.
- **Studied moment:** around 16.3s, a diagonal perspective wall of large panels becomes an elliptical belt of small screenshots orbiting a centred sentence, which keeps adding words.
- **Transfer:** a compact orbit of business artifacts (request, photos, appointment, quote) around one stable sentence. It stays smooth because the centre of attention and the cards' track are shared.

**11 · Replit Slides** ([post](https://x.com/Replit/status/2049160182488576245)): cream background, black type, orange emphasis, oversized controls, named cursor.
- **Studied moment:** around 16.4s, green dots resolve into a card that grows while a colour wash reveals its regions in stages, then settles larger.
- **Transfer:** **materialise results.** The shell appears first, then status, date and action fill in order, and the completed state stays readable.

**12 · Replit Canvas** ([post](https://x.com/Replit/status/2060097656207413613)): prompt → design directions → canvas → editing → publishing.
- **Studied moment:** around 21.7s, the camera travels down a column of artboards; neighbours blur while the selected column stays sharp, and new content appears before the old leaves.
- **Transfer:** one continuous canvas from request → schedule → confirmation, with one selected card staying crisp and a single camera transform over nested UI.

**13 · Replit Parallel Agents** ([post](https://x.com/Replit/status/2053891504989753817)): red pill words, task cards, branching lines, one main app receiving updates.
- **Studied moment:** around 42–45s, four endpoints travel along thin rails, the headline swaps left-to-right, and the rails persist across the swap.
- **Transfer:** a persistent path connects the steps of a process, so words change without resetting the scene. Show merging only when the real process merges.

**14 · Adaline** ([post](https://x.com/arshdilbagi/status/2065826083224834345)): code, founder, green/cream diagrams, orbital paths, radial networks.
- **Studied moment:** around 25.8s, a globe and orbits dissolve into a radial network, and the next phrase forms in its centre.
- **Transfer:** a small consistent shape family (circles, thin lines, compact labels) can carry complex ideas quietly. Avoid low-contrast pale elements on the key message.

**15 · Pilot Protocol** ([post](https://x.com/razvanr/status/2081756497814720657)): founders with huge changing text overlays, stark black/white graphics, lime keywords.
- **Studied moment:** around 52.5s, black tiles multiply over the founder, then expose a new environment.
- **Transfer:** a tile wipe makes a good one-time chapter break, not a main transition language.

**16 · Bevel** ([post](https://x.com/greynguyen/status/2048799663638171746)): soft white space, lavender/mint light, isolated mobile screens, curved artifact rows.
- **Studied moment:** around 16s, screens arrive upward in a stack; each enters soft-focused, aligns and occludes the previous one.
- **Transfer:** stack three business cards, then collapse them to the selected one. Overlapping timing plus decreasing motion as they align reads as smooth. Keep the stack shallow so the text stays large.

**17 · Poke, seven-video campaign** ([post](https://x.com/interaction/status/2062575428213285352)): a portrait UI story (messages → calendar picker → choices → results → reminder).
- **Studied moment:** around 3–6s, an avatar pulls back into the phone; a request bubble stays readable while the background dims and a calendar sheet rises from below.
- **Transfer:** **request → picker → selected time → confirmation** is the most directly usable sequence for service businesses. Keep the request as the anchor, and make every scene show an action and its visible result.

**18 · Wonder (first video)** ([post](https://x.com/aibek_design/status/1957856991608512898)): a purple cursor, selection outlines, canvas framing, generated screens, component extraction.
- **Studied moment:** around 11–13s, the camera pulls back from a selected frame while skeleton regions appear in neighbouring artboards; the cursor keeps a meaningful target.
- **Transfer:** couple the global camera move with local UI motion, keep selection borders attached to their objects, and make sure the final state is readable after the energetic reveal.

**19 · Wonder (second video)** ([post](https://x.com/usewonder/status/2044099145997402272)): a dimensional cursor types a title, then prompt → moodboard → website → variants.
- **Studied moment:** around 2.8–3.8s, the selected title barely moves, then accelerates through the camera with stretched, blurred edges while white space clears for the next prompt.
- **Transfer:** a photo selection frame expands into the detailed inspection, then becomes the quote panel. The cursor or selection marker remains the actor.

**20 · MadeThis** ([post](https://x.com/jehovahscript/status/2082868450847031354)): a historical intro, then a blue/pastel SaaS system; a typed business prompt creates brand, shop, payments and marketing.
- **Studied moment:** around 20s, a tilted wheel of business labels advances; the active line is bright, neighbours recede, and the background hue flows.
- **Transfer:** a carousel of service steps (Inspect / Measure / Quote / Schedule) with one readable active item.

**21 · AgentArcade** ([post](https://x.com/AgentArcade/status/2077071110777029066)): a dark neon agent UI, chart cards, fanned pills, ranked rows, radar diagrams.
- **Studied moment:** around 12.2s, an upright panel folds into a luminous strip and the next card rises from below.
- **Transfer:** a perspective fold turns an estimate into a scheduled-job card. Use stronger contrast than the source, because near-black transition frames hide the story on phones.

**22 · Work Louder** ([post](https://x.com/MarkKnd/status/2022261281114468759)): keyboard macro sweeps, a suspended product, glowing key waves, then exploded physical layers with a flowing cable. Almost no copy.
- **Studied moment:** around 12.9–13.9s, parallax keyboards **hard-cut** to three exploded layers that keep drifting. It stays cohesive because geometry, palette and motion continue.
- **Transfer:** **the best physical-product reference.** Separate a product into its real layers (e.g. shingles / underlayment / deck / rafters), with disciplined camera and materials.

**23 · Contra (Indy)** ([post](https://x.com/contraben/status/1952725885146075406)): "Job boards are dead"; a black wall of posts; mascot; tiled grid; scanning counter; results.
- **Studied moment:** around 7s, a wall of posts races upward, cuts to a mascot close-up, then pulls back into a clean grid.
- **Transfer:** **information overload → one clear actor**, then a scan that visibly produces results. A wall of inspection photos resolves to one selected roof, then to an estimate or booking.

**24 · Contra (Creative Arena)** ([post](https://x.com/contraben/status/1968717444685394134)): a big "AI" premise, a constellation of creative panels and tool logos, a dive into the product, a selected vote, results.
- **Studied moment:** around 9.3–10.3s, the centred claim and logos scale through the camera with stretched letters while the destination website is already visible underneath, then settle.
- **Transfer:** **the model foreground fly-through.** The business promise flies past to reveal the product or measured object. Show two options, select one, and let the selected panel become the next scene.

**25 · Bolt.new** ([post](https://x.com/boltdotnew/status/2039024467846860972)): giant kinetic problem/solution type, blue light on black, code panels, prompt → site, merge → confirmation.
- **Studied moment:** around 19s, the brand letterform scales up until its hole fills the frame and becomes the next scene.
- **Transfer:** use a brand shape (e.g. a roofline) as a portal; action → button → "ready/booked" status with truthful wording. Strike-through text replacement is another strong move.

**26 · Tembo** ([post](https://x.com/benjaminakar/status/1985754174911627546)): minimal black-on-white; automation setup screens; result panels; template cards.
- **Studied moment:** around 40s, one card moves to centre, then its copies fan diagonally as the camera pulls back.
- **Transfer:** one inspection becomes a fan of options or completed projects, with the selected front card preserved. The overall pace is too calm for short ads.

**27 · Conduit** ([post](https://x.com/0xpunnk/status/2062598516544061537)): a hospitality image stack, a message constellation, founder footage, action tags, a gradient brand reveal, an ops demo.
- **Studied moment:** around 28.3s, a soft coloured cloud takes over the frame as the logo settles.
- **Transfer:** one colour-field breath for the brand handoff. Its clear input → work → result business vocabulary is the real lesson.

**28 · Extend** ([post](https://x.com/kushalbyatnal/status/2059278322287214750)): a big statistic, an orbiting document sphere, benchmark charts, an isometric document with coloured semantic regions.
- **Studied moment:** around 64–67s, a perspective document keeps its registered colour regions while a scan completes; the regions lift as planes, then category cards reveal diagonally.
- **Transfer:** **registered decomposition.** The source object stays recognisable while its parts become structured outputs (roof plan → measured planes → scope items).

---

## Cross-film takeaways for business ads

- The strongest films never cut to an unrelated layout without a carried object, matched direction or pre-positioned destination.
- Physical products get material realism and exploded structure (Work Louder); software gets cursor/selection causality (Wonder, Replit); services get request → choice → confirmation (Poke).
- Long founder/talking-head grammar and slow historical intros don't fit a 15–30s business ad.
- Near-black transition frames and pale low-contrast text on key messages hurt phone viewing.
